sources.note: Defines four strategic goals. Goal 3: Varmistetaan yhdenvertainen ja vaikuttava syövänhoito. Goal 3 follow-up metrics include: 5-year survival of poor-prognosis cancers reaching Nordic level; 10% reduction in cancer mortality; patients start treatment within target timeframes. Goal 2 includes the ≥70% stage I–II diagnosis metric.
